<h2>Build a Shared Interpolation Descriptor</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Shares interpolation data with [mori::share()] and returns a stable
descriptor instead of persisting a process-local memory handle.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_shared_interpolation_data(data_interpolation = NULL, registry_key = NULL)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_interpolation">data_interpolation</code></td>
<td>
<p>A data frame to share across local worker processes.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="registry_key">registry_key</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional non-empty key used to retain the shared object in a
process-local registry. Reusing a key replaces the previous region.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>The live memory name is written to the store-scoped directory in
'BIODYNAMICS_INTERPOLATION_SHARED_REGISTRY'. Workers must treat the
mapped data as read-only.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A list containing 'registry_key' and deterministic 'source_hash'.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[mori::share()]
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>data_interpolation &lt;-
  tibble::tibble(dataset_name = "core_a")

data_shared &lt;-
  build_shared_interpolation_data(
    data_interpolation = data_interpolation
  )
</code></pre>
